The 2020 Law That Turned Your IRA Into a Tax Trap
youtube_short.description: In 2020, the SECURE Act quietly eliminated the stretch IRA — the strategy that let heirs spread inherited IRA withdrawals over a lifetime. Now every non-spouse heir must drain the account in just 10 years, which can create a massive taxable income spike and cost you up to $85,000 in extra taxes. The fix is simple: spread your withdrawals evenly across all 10 years. And if you inherit a Roth IRA, you get it completely tax-free. Follow for more hidden money traps nobody warns you about. #inheritedira #secureact #taxes #personalfinance #retirementplanning
